Every declared section, after-table marker, after-region marker, and final summary remains present in source order.
Each table's body-row order matches the predeclared inventory, independently of horizontal neighbor extraction order.

Short neighbors do not acquire repeated headers/footers solely because the longer parallel table continues.

All declared fragment links and source destinations survive according to the renderer's supported annotation/destination contract.
Monitoring terminal summaries appear once; they are not qualified as tfoot repetition.
Assess closed/open native details separately using expected.details. Closed body labels are present in HTML source but absent from visible output.
Use Edge as an independent native print oracle; compare semantic inventories and inspect representative page geometry without requiring pixel equality.
